subject: Kestrel Logistics — PO prerequisites & AP portal enrollment
messages:
From: Julia Silverman <j.silverman@kestrellogistics.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts.payable@kestrellogistics.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO prerequisites & vendor setup for Redwood

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Kestrel would like to add Redwood as an approved supplier so we can issue POs and pay for pilot usage. Our AP team asked me to collect the vendor onboarding artifacts so they can create the vendor record in Oracle. Could you confirm the following and send the requested files?

- Legal entity name for vendor record (exact):
- W-9 or VAT registration (depending on entity)
- Bank remit details (account, routing/IBAN, beneficiary name)
- W-9/Tax ID: are we a US entity or do you operate via a UK/EU branch for this account?
- Remit email for invoice delivery (AP email or billing mailbox)
- Point of contact for invoice disputes and PO acknowledgement
- Sample invoice (PDF) matching the PO line-item format so our system can map fields
- Certificate of Insurance (GL and Cyber) if available

Separately, do you support supplier portal enrollment (we prefer portal-supplied invoices for POs > $25k)? If so, please include instructions and a contact for portal activation.

If you can get the packet over by EOD Wednesday we can turn the vendor record around next week.

Appreciate it — Julia
Julia Silverman
Senior Procurement Partner
Kestrel Logistics
j.silverman@kestrellogistics.com


From: avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
To: Julia Silverman <j.silverman@kestrellogistics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & vendor setup for Redwood

Julia — thanks for the clear checklist. Friendly note: copying our Finance lead Laura and Sales Ops Karthik to own the artifact delivery and portal steps. We can provide everything below and will attach the files to this thread.

Requested details (summary):
- Legal entity (exact): Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID / W-9: attached (Redwood_W9_2027.pdf) — US entity / EIN included
- Bank remit: attached (Redwood_Bank_Remittance_Sept2027.pdf) — ACH routing and wire beneficiary included
- Remit email: billing@redwoodinference.com (please route invoices to this mailbox or upload via portal)
- Invoice PO matching: we accept PO number in the invoice header and on the invoice line-item; sample invoice attached
- POC for disputes / PO ack: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com (AP escalation)
- Insurance: attached COI (Insurance_Certificate_Redwood.pdf)
- Portal: we support supplier portal enrollment; next message has steps and the portal contact.

Attachments in this message: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf; Redwood_Bank_Remittance_Sept2027.pdf; Insurance_Certificate_Redwood.pdf; AP_Portal_Quickstart_Steps.pdf

If your AP system requires a specific invoice XML/CSV schema or a special field for project codes, send a sample and Karthik will map it to our billing system.

Avery Johnson

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Julia Silverman <j.silverman@kestrellogistics.com>, avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & vendor setup for Redwood

Hi Julia,

Thanks — I am Laura in Finance and will be your AP contact for vendor record setup and any invoice routing exceptions. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Invoice matching rules — please confirm which of these you require (we can include the PO number and match to the following fields):
   - PO Number (required)
   - Invoice Date
   - Line Item Description
   - Unit Price / Quantity
   - Ship-to / Bill-to (we usually provide a single bill-to address per PO)

2) Payment terms — our standard Net 30 via ACH. If Kestrel requires a different term for onboarding POs, let us know and we'll escalate.

3) Portal enrollment — if your portal requires a supplier admin user, we recommend assigning the email billing@redwoodinference.com. Karthik, can you confirm if we should create an additional portal-only user for AP visibility?

4) Tax: we are a US-headquartered vendor (EIN on W-9). If you need VAT registration documents for a separate EU entity, we do have a Redwood EU LTD entity but we will only use that when POs are issued to that legal entity. Please confirm which legal entity appears on the PO.

I've attached the quickstart with a short checklist to accelerate mapping. Happy to do a 30-minute screen share with your AP team to walk through sample invoice mapping and portal upload flow. Proposed slots: Wed 22 Sep 10:00-10:30PT or Thu 23 Sep 13:00-13:30PT.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com


From: Julia Silverman <j.silverman@kestrellogistics.com>

- Create vendor record for Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN verified via attached W-9)

- Expect invoices to include the PO number in header; please ensure the sample invoice matches the final invoice format
- Payment term Net 30 ACH — accepted
- We will attach PO mapping notes in the portal; the AP team would like the Wed 22 Sep 10:00PT slot for the screen share if that still works for you (our team prefers 10:00).

I will also upload a small test PO to the portal once the supplier admin user is confirmed — that will let you validate invoice parsing/matching.

Thanks — Julia
